Summer22.title: Slope mostly gone; 2022 MC still has too many jets
Summer22.body: Two fixes in this run. The DY MC now gets the Z pT shape from Z→μμ data, and electrons no longer make fake MET (jets that are really an electron are left out of the MET, as in the JME recipe). Data/MC is now 0.97 ± 0.01 (Z→ee) and 0.99 ± 0.01 (Z→μμ), up from 0.95 and 0.97. A small slope in Z pT is left in both channels: about 0.95 below 30 GeV and 1.04 above 100 GeV.
next: 2022 jets: the MC has about 5% more jets and a bigger MET tail than data. Without JER smearing most of the MET tail goes away, but not the extra jets. Next: check the 2022 JER inputs with JME.
Full run on condor, to get the pileup and jet-multiplicity shapes right.
b/c-tag SFs once we cut on the tagger.

Summer23BPix.title: Slope gone; electrons still about 3% below muons
Summer23BPix.body: Two fixes in this run. The DY MC now gets the Z pT shape from Z→μμ data, and electrons no longer make fake MET (jets that are really an electron are left out of the MET, as in the JME recipe). The MET fix matters most here: leading-electron pT 200–300 GeV went from 0.61 to 0.91. Data/MC is now 0.98 ± 0.01 (Z→ee) and 1.01 ± 0.01 (Z→μμ), up from 0.94 and 0.99, and flat in Z pT.
next: Electrons are still about 3% below muons, mostly at negative η, before any jet cut. Ask EGM about the 2023D electron ID SFs.
Full run on condor, to get the pileup and jet-multiplicity shapes right.
b/c-tag SFs once we cut on the tagger.
